about.title: About me
about.intro: I am a software engineer with experience building enterprise applications and collaborating across teams to deliver maintainable solutions.
about.background: My work at Teradata includes ownership of OPF and Consumption/Usage, frontend development, API integration, automated testing, and troubleshooting across application and infrastructure boundaries.
about.approach: I care about understanding the problem, making technical decisions explicit, and keeping software understandable for the people who maintain it.
about.direction: I am deepening my Angular, React, and TypeScript expertise while expanding my backend and system design skills.

teradataEngineer.summary: Own feature development across OPF, Consumption/Usage, and Connection Manager, including an ongoing Angular-to-React migration, while contributing to enterprise applications across Console, AIS, and Notebooks.

highlights.ownership: Took end-to-end ownership of Connection Manager during a team transition, becoming a primary technical point of contact and coordinating implementation, technical decisions, and issue resolution across teams.
highlights.delivery: Own features from requirements analysis and technical design through API integration, implementation, automated testing, cloud validation, debugging, and delivery.
highlights.integration: Investigate integration issues involving frontend applications, backend APIs, authentication flows, Kubernetes workloads, and remote cloud environments.
highlights.architecture: Build maintainable enterprise interfaces with Angular, React, TypeScript, RxJS, Nx, Signals, reusable components, dependency injection, and Jest-based unit testing.
highlights.collaboration: Coordinate with other engineering teams when problems cross application or service boundaries.
highlights.ai: Use AI-assisted workflows to support code analysis, debugging, and repetitive engineering tasks.
highlights.migration: Lead the technical direction and implementation of the Consumption/Usage migration from Angular to React, integrating React as a remote within the existing monorepo while maintaining both implementations in parallel.
highlights.uxAlignment: Own new feature development across OPF and Consumption/Usage, aligning existing interfaces and new functionality with UX designs and established design principles.

teradataIntern.summary: Contributed to production enterprise UI applications before transitioning into a full-time software engineering role.

highlights.development: Developed practical experience with Angular, TypeScript, testing, API integration, and large-scale development practices.
highlights.collaboration: Worked within collaborative development, code review, and Agile delivery processes.

axolote.summary: Collaborated on a responsive web application for a fragrance business.

highlights.delivery: Built and delivered a client web application as part of a freelance development team.
highlights.contribution: Contributed to UI/UX design, frontend development, backend functionality, and implementation of client requirements.
